title: 출입국사무소에서 외국인등록하기: 뭐가 있어야 돼요?
objective: Use -아야/어야 to say what is needed first.
summary: A student registers as a foreign resident and learns what she needs to get her card.
setting: The counter of a local immigration office. Lina, an international student, has booked online to register as a foreign resident.

task.title: Use what you learned
task.line: Use -아야/어야 and the new words from the dialogue to complete each item.

words.meaning: residence card (the ID card for registered foreigners)
words.exampleMeaning: The bank asked me to show my residence card.
Can I fill out the application form in English?
I'm going to move out of the dormitory next semester.

words.meaning: confirmation letter (a paper that proves something)
words.exampleMeaning: I got a confirmation letter from the school office.

words.meaning: receipt (proof that your application was taken)
words.exampleMeaning: What do I do if I lose the receipt?
I got a text saying my card is ready.

dialogue.korean: 외국인등록을 하러 왔어요. 예약은 인터넷으로 했어요.
dialogue.meaning: I came to do my foreigner registration. I booked online.
OK. Please give me your application form, passport, and photo.

dialogue.korean: 여기 있어요. 저는 학교 기숙사에 살아요.
dialogue.meaning: Here you are. I live in the school dormitory.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 기숙사 확인서가 있어야 주소를 등록할 수 있어요. 가져오셨어요?
dialogue.meaning: Then you need a dormitory confirmation letter before I can register your address. Did you bring it?
Can I get my registration card today?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 카드가 나와야 받을 수 있어요. 나오면 문자로 알려 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: No. You can only get it once the card is made. When it's ready, we'll let you know by text.

dialogue.korean: 찾으러 오실 때 이 접수증을 꼭 가져오세요. 접수증이 있어야 카드를 드릴 수 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: When you come to pick it up, be sure to bring this receipt. We can only give you the card if you have the receipt.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -아야/어야 (내다): 신청서를 ____ 접수가 끝나요.
Join the two parts with -아야/어야 and end with -어요: ① 번호표를 뽑다 / 순서를 기다릴 수 있다 ② 신청서에 서명하다 / 접수할 수 있다
Fill in the blanks with -아야/어야: ① 접수증이 (있다) ____ 카드를 받을 수 있어요. ② 카드가 (나오다) ____ 받을 수 있어요.
Read the dialogue and answer in English: How will Lina know her card is ready, and what must she bring when she picks it up?
answers: ① 번호표를 뽑아야 순서를 기다릴 수 있어요. ② 신청서에 서명해야 접수할 수 있어요.
She will get a text message (문자). She must bring the application receipt (접수증).
